prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Render a polished actual desktop application page edge to edge at 1536x1024 landscape, no browser/device frame. Use the attached approved review screen as the strict visual system: compact 68px horizontal header with Private Client Graph brand, Matters as the only primary navigation and neutral account icon; thin synthetic-only notice strip; paper #F6F6F1, white work areas, deep green #173E38, rules #C9CEC8, muted #59655F, burgundy #773B46 only for focus/destructive actions, gold only for source Evidence highlights. Newsreader-like serif titles, Public Sans-like body and controls. No invented profile, timestamps, owners, status chips, tabs, metrics, cards, shadows or decorative art. Match reference spacing, type sizes, simple squared buttons and precise rules. All content explicitly fictional. Design the Matters collection page. Preserve header and exact synthetic boundary 'This prototype accepts synthetic or fictional material only. It is not suitable for real confidential client information.' Main content has comfortable side margins around 100px, max-width professional register. Heading 'Matters' with primary 'Create Matter' button right aligned. Subtitle 'Open a Matter or return to a proposal awaiting confirmation.' First section 'Awaiting confirmation' with one sentence 'These saved proposals need your review before a Matter is created.' Thin ruled table with only two columns 'Matter reference' and 'Matter', 220px first column. Two fictional rows: 'SYN-2026-014' / 'Evergreen family trust'; 'SYN-2026-018' / 'Willow family arrangements'. Full row is a navigation link, title Newsreader 20px and reference sans 15px. First row shows understated hover tint and title underline. No arrows, checkboxes, extra row actions or statuses. Below after 48px spacing second section 'Accepted Matters', sentence 'Return to accepted relationships and their source evidence.' Same exact two-column register, three rows 'SYN-2026-003' / 'Cedar family settlement', 'SYN-2026-007' / 'Hawthorn succession planning', 'SYN-2026-011' / 'Birch family trust'. Two clearly separate collections with sober headings, no rounded card containers. At bottom a thin rule and quiet footer 'Private Client Graph' left, 'Synthetic material only' right. Page not overly sparse, all five rows visible at natural 64px row height, no invented counters or dashboard.
